en: Dependent on a root phenomenon that is both a root and accompanied by a root, there arises a non-root phenomenon that is neither a root nor non-root, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of the root; ... pe ... one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon that is accompanied by a root but is not itself a root, there arises a phenomenon that is neither non-root nor non-non-root, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of the root; ... pe ... one in the case of non-disappearance.
